title: Storage Drawer
body:
"A drawer for all of your storage needs! Allows you to store items within the structure. Storage drawers have a limit of 250 per drawer, and only allow the same item & type to be stored per drawer. With logic, an input of 100 can toggle the input lock on the drawer. An input from 1 to 10 will attempt to output x amount of it's contents."

The Storage Drawer is a structure that can be used to store up to 250 of a single item. The maximum dimensions are 8 x 8 x 8 studs. They can be bought at Jerry's Junk shop beside the Lighthouse for 26,800$ each. There is also a smaller version, the Micro Storage Drawer.
